For a Thai citizen planning a 31-day stay in Vietnam, you'll need to apply for an e-Visa — the 30-day visa-free exemption for Thai passport holders doesn't quite cover your trip since it's 1 day over the limit.

**Primary pathway: e-Visa**
- Thailand's bilateral visa-free arrangement only covers stays up to 30 days, and your 31-day trip exceeds that, so the visa-free option doesn't apply here.
- The e-Visa allows stays of up to 90 days, so it comfortably covers your 31 days.

**Key details**
- Cost: USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry)
- Apply at the official portal: https://evisa.gov.vn/
- Processing time: 2-3 business days (expedited options available at extra cost)
- Valid for entry by air, land, or sea, at any of the approved e-Visa ports
- Your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date

**Note:** If you can trim your trip to 30 days or fewer, you could travel visa-free instead. Otherwise, the e-Visa is your best route for 31 days.

This is based on policy data as of 2026-08-17 — please double-check current requirements at evisa.gov.vn before you travel, since immigration policy can change.
